summary: Operator surfaced a major design brief (diary-first wedge reframe, Mycelium 5-layer model, six-kinds review, AI-defenses inventory, no-better-plan competitive framing, Shamir cascade recovery with operator's own no-pre-stashed-key sharpening, OTS-port-from-AppCommander, phase-mapping changes). Carpenter engaged substantively in chat — acknowledged the wedge reframe, recommended adding a journal kind to tapit-attest, flagged a technical clarification for the Shamir recovery design (split the encryption key for the cloud blob, NOT the signing keypair), proposed Phase 2.5 (diary surface) and Phase 2.75/early-3 (OTS port) ahead of Phase 3 inter-app, pushed back on framing recovery as a marketing moment and on letting the bot ever sign. Brief filed verbatim with the Carpenter response captured in a footer; 10 idea entries logged to ideas.md per the LIVING-IDEAS doctrine. CLAUDE_ROOT.md was discovered landing on main via AppCommander bootstrap commit f61cf2d between fetch and push; merged into branch, stale 'not yet present' notes corrected, gates re-run green, pushed.

why.text: Operator asked the Carpenter to 'chew on this and tell me what you think.' Primary deliverable: substantive engagement in chat. Secondary deliverable: preservation per LIVING-IDEAS doctrine — every meaningful idea surfaced gets logged in the same session it surfaced. The brief is large enough that filing it verbatim plus the idea entries is the honest record. The bootstrap-merge surprise was a real-world reminder that origin can move under your feet — handled by fetching before pushing and merging cleanly when divergence is orthogonal.

outcome.notes: Three commits on the feature branch this session: b78b867 (brief + ideas), 56c9740 (merge of origin/main bringing in CLAUDE_ROOT.md), 28fb359 (correct stale 'not yet present' notes). Branch and main both at 28fb359. No wallet implementation changes — this was an intake session, not a cut session. Phase 2.5 (diary surface), Phase 2.75 (OTS port), and journal-kind addition to tapit-attest are all proposals awaiting operator greenlight.

uncertainty: Whether the operator wants Phase 2.5 cut next or wants further design conversation on the recovery cascade / journal kind decisions before code lands. The brief itself names everything as 'suggestions, not job orders' so the next move is a direction signal from the operator, not autonomous Carpenter execution.
next: Operator decides which of the proposals to greenlight: (a) add journal kind to tapit-attest as a precursor to Phase 2.5, (b) cut Phase 2.5 (diary surface — composer + journal-kind attestation + entry cards on home + selective-recall view + mocked anchor), (c) cut Phase 2.75 (OTS port from AppCommander), (d) something else from the brief, or (e) continue browser verification of Phases 1+2 first. The Carpenter recommendation is the sequence a → b → c then revisit Phase 3.
